name: Bob's CLI
description: A local-first AI coding CLI that adapts to you. Runs on your own hardware with zero API costs and zero data leaving your machine. Lives in your terminal, sees your actual files, and provides AI assistance directly in your native terminal.
community_quotes: Local-first architecture with complete privacy
Zero API costs - runs on your own hardware
Senior-level AI engineering partner in your terminal
No data leaves your machine

name: Qursor
description: Point at any UI to send exact context to your AI. An inspector tool that captures precise UI elements and sends accurate context to AI assistants, solving issues with command misalignment and token waste in AI interactions.
community_quotes: Launch of the Day on June 12, 2026
#3 Product of the Day
Solves command misalignment in AI coding
Reduces token waste in AI interactions

name: Publora
description: The Publishing API for the Agent Era. One API call publishes to 10 social platforms simultaneously with no SDKs or OAuth wiring. Features an MCP server with 18 tools for Claude, Cursor, Codex, OpenClaw, and Windsurf. Enables AI agents to post, comment, react, schedule, and manage content programmatically.
community_quotes: #1 Product of the Week (June 8, 2026)
Over 600 upvotes on Product Hunt
One API call publishes to 10 platforms
MCP server with 18 tools for AI coding environments

name: OpenYabby
description: An open-source voice-driven multi-agent orchestration system for AI coding workflows. Integrates with Claude Code and other CLI runners to enable project-scale development through coordinated agents. Features persistent memory, multi-channel support (WhatsApp, Discord, Slack), and hierarchical agent teams for planning, execution, and review cycles.
community_quotes: Voice-driven multi-agent assistant for real project building
Combines Realtime API + CLI runners + multi-channel orchestration
Open-source alternative to closed AI assistants
Runner-agnostic: supports Claude Code, Codex, Aider, Goose, Cline, and Continue

name: Browse.sh
description: Give your agents muscle memory for automating the web. A behavior cache system that records agent tool-calling patterns and intelligently swaps between script-based execution and LLM-based execution to optimize repetitive automations.
community_quotes: #2 Product of the Week (June 8, 2026)
Behavior cache for AI agents
Gets LLMs out of the hot path of repetitive automations
Hybridization of software scripts and agents

name: agmsg
description: Stop copy-pasting between your AI coding agents. An open-source CLI tool that lets Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, and Copilot CLI message each other directly through a shared SQLite database, eliminating the need for developers to act as a copy-paste relay.
community_quotes: Direct agent-to-agent messaging between different AI coding tools
Shared SQLite database for message passing
Eliminates copy-paste relay between AI agents
Open-source project

name: Zot
description: A lightweight, single-binary coding agent harness written in Go. Supports multiple providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, DeepSeek, Google Gemini, local models), four built-in tools (read, write, edit, bash), extensions in any language, swarm mode for background subagents, controllable sessions, and a built-in Telegram bridge.
community_quotes: Yet another coding agent harness - posted June 4, 2026
Single Go binary, no runtime, no Docker, no package manager
Supports most major AI providers and local models
Telegram bridge for remote agent control
